literal_meaning: ঘরের মধ্যে গুপ্তঘর; সিঁড়ির নীচের ধাপের ঘর
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়ির চোরাকুঠিতে পুরনো চিঠিপত্র লুকিয়ে রেখেছি।
শিশুরা চোরাকুঠিতে খেলতে খুব উৎসাহী হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: I have hidden old letters in the house's secret nook.
Children are very excited to play in the hideout.
history: In traditional Bengali homes, especially in rural areas, secret rooms under stairs were built to hide valuables from thieves or during times of unrest.
note: Often associated with the game of hide-and-seek (চোরাকুঠি খেলা) in Bengali culture.
